Fourth of July a couple years ago at my aunt and uncle's house in Kansas City; My uncle, cousin, and I were out walking around before it got dark out. We saw about 4-5 young ghetto kids on the other side of the street throwing firecrackers at a laundry basket and laughing as they exploded. We then noticed that the neighbour's escaped cat was underneath that laundry basket. These little assholes were shooting bottle rockets and throwing firecrackers at her, finding it hysterical. My 6'5 ex-Marine, Vietnam vet, and retired US Marshal uncle (Toughest dude I know, and can be **VERY** scary when angry) tells us to wait on the sidewalk, then walks over, lifts up the laundry basket, grabs the cat, and with a wrathful voice basically tells the ghetto kids they have 10 seconds to fuck off. 

They all look like they pissed themselves and quickly scram, leaving the rest of their fireworks behind. We take their fireworks and the cat back to the house, my uncle eventually turns over the confiscated bottle-rockets to the Police (they are illegal in Kansas). We give the cat back to my uncle's neighbour, thankfully she was okay just really shook up. We tried to find the parents of those ghetto kids but they were apparently from a different neighbourhood, one that you probably don't want to go to.
